|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Bacta Infirmary (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The Virtual Block 7.3 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image print this text. No published image shows the errata text; [[Bacta Infirmary (Errata)]] uses a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB7-03-Bacta_Infirmary-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (official text as of 3 June 2011): “If Center Of Tyranny on table, deploy on table. Insurrection is lost. Rogue Squadron pilots of ability < 3 are forfeit +1 and, if just lost from table, may be placed here. During your control phase, may use 2 Force to take any character from here into hand. [Immune to Alter]”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 3 June 2011"; copy re-made 25 July 2011). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 22) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Bacta Infirmary (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Bacta Infirmary (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 December 2012) changed “Center Of Tyranny on table” to “Center of Tyranny on Table”, “+1 and, if just lost” to “+1 and if lost”, “control phase, may use 2 Force to take any character from here” to “control phase may use 2 force to take a character here” (the card list writes the Immune to Alter icon as “(Immune to Alter.)”): “If Center of Tyranny on Table, deploy on table. Insurrection is lost. Rogue Squadron pilots of ability < 3 are forfeit +1 and if lost from table, may be placed here. During your control phase may use 2 force to take a character here into hand. [Immune to Alter]”.<ref name="cl-1273_32-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>
